name: OGB Large-Scale Challenge: PCBA (ogbg-pcba)
description: A molecular property prediction benchmark of 437,929 molecules represented as graphs, with 128 binary bioassay labels from PubChem. This record describes the dataset and does not distribute data.
citation: Hu, W., Fey, M., Zitnik, M., Dong, Y., Ren, H., Liu, B., Catasta, M., & Leskovec, J. (2020). Open Graph Benchmark: Datasets for Machine Learning on Graphs. Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems, 33, 22118–22133. https://arxiv.org/abs/2005.00687
